nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle¶

Global GPU/CPU backend toggle for the nvitk GUI.

Uses the same backend selection as CLI entry points (apply_cli_backend() / --backend cpu|gpu).

Functions¶

backend_label(→ str)

Human-readable label for the active global backend.

set_gui_backend(→ nvitk.core.backend.BackendName)

Set process-wide backend from cpu / gpu (same as nvitk-gui --backend).

set_gpu_backend(→ nvitk.core.backend.BackendName)

Toggle GPU on/off via set_gui_backend() (gpu / cpu).

build_gpu_toggle_button(*[, on_changed])

Checkable button that toggles the global nvitk backend.
